# Contact brand marks

WhatsApp, Xiaohongshu, Instagram, LinkedIn and GitHub SVGs are sourced from
Simple Icons, pinned to version 11.15.0:
https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/11.15.0/icons

Original silhouettes are retained. The adapter supplies `currentColor` to
match the portfolio's pale blue palette. Generic email, phone and location
icons are small code-native outline drawings, not replacements for brand marks.

Simple Icons source project: https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons
Project license: CC0-1.0. Brand names and marks belong to their respective owners.
